name: Fill Table
description: Fill a template's table from a list: the row whose cells hold {{item.sku}}, {{item.qty}}, {{item.total}} is repeated once per record with its styles, and the formulas below it — a SUM over the lines, a grand total — are shifted and their ranges extended to cover every row. The template is designed in Excel; the flow only supplies the list.

'' : val; return; } cell.value = v.replace(marker, (s, k) => { const val = get(item, k); return val == null ? '' : String(val); }); }); } if (n === 0) ws.spliceRows(tRow, 1); const delta = n === 0 ? -1 : shift; const last = tRow + Math.max(n, 1) - 1; if (delta !== 0) ws.eachRow({ includeEmpty: false }, (row, rn) => { if (rn <= last) return; row.eachCell({ includeEmpty: false }, (cell) => { const v = cell.value; if (!v || typeof v !== 'object' || !v.formula) return; let f = v.formula.replace(ref, (s, d1, col, d2, r) => (+r > tRow ? d1 + col + d2 + (+r + delta) : s)); if (n > 0) f = f.replace(new RegExp(':(\\\\$?)([A-Z]{1,3})(\\\\$?)' + tRow + '(?!\\\\d)', 'g'), (s, d1, col, d2) => ':' + d1 + col + d2 + last); cell.value = { formula: f }; }); }); return workbook; })() }}"}]
